# Codrops GridLoadingAnimations runtime dependencies

Integrated from https://github.com/codrops/GridLoadingAnimations

These are the original browser-ready vendor builds required by the adapted grid:
- anime.js (MIT)
- imagesLoaded (MIT)
- Masonry (MIT)

The original license and copyright headers are retained in each JavaScript file.
They are loaded as classic scripts on the Shop page only to preserve their original
UMD browser-global behavior. No Codrops demo HTML, image samples or sponsor assets
are included.
